verdict.rationale: Requesty's Mintlify API reference has an interactive "Try it" runner on each endpoint, plus generated cURL, Python and TypeScript samples, all backed by a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec. The playground runs requests against the production router with a real key, so there is no sandbox or test-mode isolation. The probe's 404s were on other candidate paths, not the advertised spec URL, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the runner works, and a sandbox or test-key mode separate from production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify API reference runs the default interactive playground with a "Try it" runner per endpoint
